messages:
alex: Heads-up — sketching a 'penalty ledger' idea to bias routing toward cheaper variants for low-tier customers but still track real cost impact. want quick feedback before i sketch console UX

maya: tl;dr of the ledger? just counters or full accounting?

alex: full-ish. per-tenant ledger entries that record: chosen_variant, base_cost, actual_token_cost, delta, reason_tag, region. then emit metrics: cost_saved, cost_regressions, degrade_count. small sketch below.

liam: curious about sampling. per-request ledger will be noisy and expensive to store. do we aggregate at 1m? 5m? or sample 1% with full data?

alex: agree. proposal: 100% counters + 1% full rows for audit. counters: cumulative token_delta, requests_degraded, requests_fallbacked. full rows for anomalies only.

maya: console hooks: we should show a per-tenant 'degrade risk' score, and a timeline of when routing switched variants. that helps support debug. also need clear SLA note when low-tier client gets cheaper variant.

liam: telemetry metrics suggestion: rtre_variant_degrade_total{tenant,region,variant} and rtre_token_delta_sum{tenant}. also a histogram for latency delta.

alex: +1. also thinking about region penalty multipliers — e.g., cheaper variant in eu-west might actually be more expensive because of cross-region network cost. ledger should include region_penalty field so cost math is consistent.

maya: policy API naming bikeshed: 'economy_preference' vs 'cost_priority' vs 'variant_preference'. which reads better in code?

liam: prefer 'cost_priority' for API flags (boolean or enum). 'economy_preference' ambiguous.

alex: leaning 'cost_priority' enum: {off, prefer_cheaper, force_cheaper}. default off. yields nicer semantics for rollouts.

maya: UI: expose a slider for 'cost_priority' with tooltips: "Prefer cheaper variants when capacity constraints or budget triggers are active". also an advanced toggle for region multipliers.

srebot: NOTICE: canary deploy scheduled for routing-service at 2025-07-04T10:15Z. link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/routing/1245

liam: quick nit: we should record the 'decision_reason' string on each degrade event: e.g., "quota-exhausted", "token-budget", "latency-sla-breach" — helps correlate with alerting.

alex: agreed. decision_reason will be one of predefined enums + free text optional. we should not bloat metric labels though. use enums for metrics and stash free text in sample rows.

maya: config prototype (for policy service):
```
policy: {
  name: "penalty_ledger_v1",
  cost_priority: "prefer_cheaper",
  sample_rate: 0.01,
  aggregate_interval_sec: 60,
  region_penalties: { "eu-west": 1.12, "us-east": 1.0 },
  rules: [
    { tier: "starter", prefer: "smol-quant", max_tokens_override: 4096 }
  ]
}
```

alex: nice. one more UX ask: when a canary flips traffic to cheaper variants, console should show projected monthly $ delta if that routing persisted. helps product folks justify.

liam: math for projection: use recent 30d token rate * observed token_delta average * price_per_token. add confidence band. not perfect but useful.

maya: privacy/regulatory: for private deployments we can't ship tenant-ledger rows back to hosted telemetry. make sure ledger respects deployment_mode: {hosted, dedicated, private} and zeroes PII in private.

alex: noted. we'll default to counters-only for private + opt-in full rows via config.

liam: one more operational thought: keep an LRU cache for recent ledger totals in routing-service to avoid hitting central store on every request. sync to central store on aggregates.

maya: do we want per-tenant quota shaping tied to ledger feedback? e.g., if token_delta spikes we throttle cheaper fallback rate for a tenant to avoid big cost swings.

alex: interesting. could be a later phase: ledger-driven shaping. initially just surface signals and allow manual rules.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service v1.24.canary -> 10% traffic.

liam: to-do list from thread: 1) define metric names and enums (i'll draft) 2) storage design for sampled rows (alex) 3) console widgets: projected cost delta + timeline (maya) 4) API/SDK flag name finalization (cost_priority)

maya: putting a rough mock in figma today, will share link. :eyes:

alex: thanks all. if no objections i'll PR the schema + policy API tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
